source_document: 2026-27 NBA Regular Season Schedule By Date
source_document_header: 2026-27 NBA REGULAR SEASON SCHEDULE AS OF AUGUST 13, 2026 | SUBJECT TO CHANGE
extraction_tool: fetch_page (PDF text extraction, chunk 2) + nba.com games pages for 11/17, 11/18 and 11/19

window.rule: requested maximum horizon of 3 days from the observation time; games tipping off on or after 2026-11-20T15:45:00Z are outside the window. Every game on 11/17, 11/18 and 11/19 tips before that time, so all three dates are inside the window (5 + 12 + 4 = 21 games, the same count the official games pages print for those dates).

basis.away_home_rule: The schedule PDF prints two team cells and, on rows 215-259, prints no 'at' or 'vs' token between them. The away/home reading is therefore taken from the official injury report's matchup code (AWAY@HOME) when that report prints the same game and date, from the printed 'at' token where one exists (rows 260-273), and is otherwise corroborated by the games-page slug (away-vs-home).

games_page_corroboration.rule: the schedule extraction is the file of record; the games-page fields are added alongside it and no printed value in it is overwritten

time_column_note: The schedule PDF prints two start-time columns. On every row whose home venue is in a non-Eastern zone the two columns differ by the venue's offset from Eastern time and on rows with an Eastern home venue they are equal, so the second column is the Eastern-time start on 17 of the 21 window rows. The four rows where the games page and the injury report disagree with the schedule PDF (256, 257, 266, 267) keep both printed values and are flagged.
